args: 1_ directors alon and shaul schwarz don't stop there.
3_viewers will likely feel the urge to contact a genealogist after seeing alon and shaul schwarz's fascinating and moving documentary about amazing revelations concerning their own family.

4_the remarkable tale it tells - of a family split up and dispersed to different continents, and the detective work required to figure out what had happened - turns this documentary into a fascinating mystery of reshuffled identities.
